layers.name: Rim low points and surveyed pit bottom

props.name: North notch
props.note: Spill point today. Cap toe and main outlet. End of cap, start of NWWRP excavation.

props.name: Northeast saddle
props.note: Low point of the rim. Secondary outlet.

props.name: Southeast saddle
props.note: Low point of the rim at the end of the old haul road cut. Secondary outlet.

props.name: Surveyed pit low point
props.note: Field survey, August 17, 2026. NAVD88.

props.name: North notch
props.note: Lowest point of the rim. Cap steps down at 3H:1V and ties in at the notch. Main cap outlet. NWWRP excavation starts here.

props.name: Northeast
props.note: Rim saddle at 1,391 ft. Cap ties down to the saddle. Secondary low point.

props.name: East bench
props.note: Cap passes over the east wall crest onto the bench. Hill above (0.2 ac) drains to the perimeter ditch.

props.name: Southeast haul road cut
props.note: Old cut drains into the pit. Fill it and cap it, tie down at its saddle. No excavation. Deep waste beyond (MW-53, 42 ft) is outside this cap.

props.name: South wall
props.note: Crest 1,402 to 1,412 ft. Knoll above the cap edge (0.2 ac) drains to the perimeter ditch.

props.name: Southwest
props.note: Small side pocket filled. Cap ties to the rim.

props.name: West bench
props.note: Level bench for 500 ft. The bench is the divide; ground falls away to the west. Native rock at the rim (SB-33).

props.name: Northwest corner
props.note: Low rim. Cap ties down to it.
